summary: AI tools such as chatbots cannot be listed as authors. Authors who use AI in preparing a manuscript, including drafting or editing text, must briefly describe that use during submission and are fully accountable for fact-checking AI outputs. Reviewers must base their reports on their own reading, may use only AI tools that guarantee manuscripts are not used for training, and must disclose any use in their cover letter.
